title: OpenAI raises USD 6.6bn at a USD 157bn valuation
summary: A HackerNoon year review (Spanish edition) calls it the largest funding round on record, with Thrive Capital and SoftBank among the investors.

title: Nobel Prize in Physics goes to John Hopfield and Geoffrey Hinton for work on artificial neural networks
summary: The prize cites foundational discoveries and inventions that enable machine learning with artificial neural networks.

title: Nobel Prize in Chemistry goes to David Baker, Demis Hassabis and John Jumper for protein design and AlphaFold
summary: Baker received half for computational protein design; Hassabis and Jumper of Google DeepMind shared half for AlphaFold protein structure prediction.

title: Tesla shows Cybercab, Robovan and Tesla Bot at its 'We, Robot' event
summary: A Chinese-language 2024 chronicle on the Alibaba Cloud developer community lists the event under 11 October (Beijing time).

title: Google backs nuclear power to supply its AI data centres, BBC reports
summary: The BBC reported on Google's investment in existing or proposed nuclear plants to meet the power demand of AI data centres.

title: Washington Post reports Character.ai hosted a chatbot of a murdered teenager until her father flagged it
summary: The Post reported that Character.ai removed the chatbot based on Jennifer Ann Crecente after her father alerted the company.

title: Florida mother sues Character.ai over her 14-year-old son's death, alleging missing safeguards
summary: CBS News reports the suit by Sewell Setzer III's mother alleges the platform lacks proper safeguards and uses addictive design.

title: Anthropic releases upgraded Claude 3.5 Sonnet and a 'computer use' feature in public beta
summary: The beta lets the model operate a computer; Anthropic also released Claude 3.5 Haiku.

title: TSMC reportedly tells the US Commerce Department that one of its advanced chips reached Huawei, Taipei Times says
summary: TSMC reportedly flagged a possible export-control breach in which a chip reached Huawei through another company with ties to the Chinese government.

title: Biden administration issues a National Security Memorandum on AI with government guidelines
summary: The New York Times reported the memorandum sets guidelines for how US agencies use AI in national security.

title: Open Source Initiative publishes its Open Source AI Definition; Euronews says Meta's Llama does not meet it
summary: The definition requires disclosure of training data, which Meta does not provide for Llama; Meta said it disagrees.

title: Telegraph reports Character.ai hosted chatbots based on Brianna Ghey and Molly Russell until prompted to remove them
summary: The Telegraph reported that the platform was prompted to remove the chatbots impersonating the two UK teenagers.

title: Jamestown Foundation reports PLA Academy of Military Sciences researchers adapted Meta's Llama for military use; Meta calls it unauthorised
summary: Meta says its Llama licence bans military use.
